_comment: Candidate experiments, priced by scripts/epistemics.py plan --spec this-file.
EVERY prior_mean AND prior_sd BELOW IS A DECLARED JUDGEMENT, NOT A MEASUREMENT.
They are committed here so they can be argued with and so a later reader can see
what was believed before the data was touched — which is the whole point of
pre-registering a prior. Change them and re-run; the ranking is reported alongside
its inputs for exactly that reason.
prior_mean is the believed TRUE annualised Sharpe of the effect. 0.0 is the
program's own measured base rate across 35 families and is the default that needs
no justification; anything above it does.
n_obs is the sample that ACTUALLY EXISTS on disk, not the sample one would like.
cluster_size/icc encode the day-clustering correction (doc 278): nominal n is not
effective n, and a design that is powered on the former and not the latter should
omega = 0.25 is the epistemic learning rate. It temper the likelihood because the
model is misspecified (non-stationarity; docs 277 and 296 both saw results fail to
survive retest). Set omega = 1.0 to see the optimistic bound.

A drawdown tool, not an edge. n_obs 2772 is nominal; this design was never built. Trial T00021.

retired._note: Doc 297 measured 1.03 bps/day excess-of-cash with an interval spanning zero, and computed 3,079 sessions to certify it beats a T-bill. 11 years is 2,772 - still short. Included so the planner says so rather than the analyst. | doc 304: fails the 2026-09-22 directive's registration floor (gross >= 20 bps/ticket): 1.03 bps/day. M4 (doc 298) also keeps the family CLOSED, with four of its five objections bar-free. A planner ADMISSIBLE is a statement about information value, not a licence to register.
retired._retired: doc 306: RETIRED on the evidence, not the planner. The planner still rates it ADMISSIBLE: at N(0, 0.5) p_cert 0.0734, informativeness 2.469; at its declared N(0.1, 0.25) p_cert 0.0562, informativeness 1.889; threshold sd 0.289 at mean 0. Doc 297 killed the sleeve: 1.566 of its 4.769 net bps is T-bill interest; excess of cash is 1.03 bps/day in 2025+, CI [-7.15, +7.63], and all 8 excess-of-cash CIs span zero; 46-59% of gross is beta x a bull sample; buy-and-hold beats it on total return 4/4 in both windows and on Sharpe 4/4 in 2025+; effective independent bets 1.50. Certifying that it beats a T-bill needs 3,079 sessions, and minute_aggs holds 2,693 SPY sessions (2,692 close-to-open pairs, 2016-01-04..2026-09-21, counted doc 306). Fails the registration floor (gross >= 20 bps/ticket). The exposure it harvests is available by holding the index, which is an allocation decision and Pierce's.
